decision_authority.source: Parent task instruction retained in the conversation handoff; this is not a human campaign GO receipt.
decision_authority.accepted_decisions: Root accepts for the 6460 exploratory report: paired rows/all signed differences, cohort mean/SD/median/W-T-L-missing,10k paired percentile bootstrap seed130102026 as descriptive marginal95% intervals, no significance/superiority labels or cross-preset winner replacement; complete-preset interval withheld if required pairs missing/unresolved. Retain all cohorts, source replication separate, own selected bank/readout. Confirmation120fits remains outside this campaign and requires later frozen scope/seeds; its unresolved node split law must not block the exploratory TRAIN/VALID benchmark.

supersedes_for_6460_reporting: benchmark_review_protocol_proposal_v1/PROPOSED_PROTOCOL.json candidate choices only; prior proposal and ancestor statistical policy remain unchanged as history.

fixed_design.sampling_unit: One paired method/control outcome row for one fixed preset and matched cohort. Source and matched scheduling groups are not extra observations.

reporting.comparisons: Publish every prescribed applicable method/control comparison in the frozen design and pinned FACTS.methods[].controls, plus the native M1/G0/I4 comparison context. Resolve task-dependent control aliases using the frozen method definitions; never invent a control or silently substitute a preset.

signed_difference.stored: lhs native metric minus rhs native metric, with endpoint name, units, direction and both exact served predictor IDs.
signed_difference.interpretation: For higher-is-better endpoints a positive difference favors lhs; for lower-is-better endpoints a negative difference favors lhs.
signed_difference.tie: Exactly equal saved native endpoint values before display rounding; no posthoc numerical or practical-effect tolerance.

cohort_summaries: all ten planned row statuses and every available signed paired difference

denominators.n_score_pairs: Number with both numeric served endpoint values available.
denominators.n_missing_pairs: Number without both numeric values; n_score_pairs+n_missing_pairs=10.
denominators.n_resolved_pairs: Scored pairs whose required own selections, state/readout identity and declared matched controller/convergence statuses are resolved.
denominators.n_unresolved_scored_pairs: Scored pairs with at least one unresolved requirement; n_resolved_pairs+n_unresolved_scored_pairs=n_score_pairs.
denominators.win_tie_loss: Directional signs among n_score_pairs; W+T+L+missing=10. Publish unresolved flags alongside signs; a descriptive sign is not a superiority declaration.

reporting.incomplete_summaries: Keep available raw scores/differences and their statuses. Any available-pair mean/SD/median must show n_score_pairs/10 and n_unresolved_scored_pairs, be explicitly incomplete, and must not be presented as a complete-preset estimate. SD is unavailable for fewer than two scored pairs.
reporting.failed_or_capped: Retain all declared outcomes, failed attempts, actual costs, selected and trained epochs, stop reasons and convergence labels. A matched trajectory at its cap without resolved convergence remains unresolved even if a selected score exists.
prohibited: pooling presets, route members, I4 bodies, molecules, nodes or dependent link queries as independent training trials
p-values or old Holm/sign-flip claims presented as the 6460-family analysis
replacing a fixed preset with another preset selected from outcomes

descriptive_uncertainty.estimand: Mean signed paired native-metric difference within one fixed preset and declared contrast.
descriptive_uncertainty.resampling_unit: Entire matched cohort row, preserving paired method/control outcomes and all dependencies within that row.
descriptive_uncertainty.implementation: For a complete preset, order the ten matched cohorts by their frozen seed/split identity. Initialize NumPy Generator(PCG64(130102026)); draw a (10000,10) integer index array uniformly with replacement from 0..9. Reuse that array for the prescribed complete contrasts of this preset. Compute each resampled mean signed difference and its 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles with linear interpolation; record numerical package version in the eventual report.
descriptive_uncertainty.coverage_label: descriptive approximate marginal 95% paired percentile interval
descriptive_uncertainty.eligibility: All ten required cohort pairs for the contrast must be present and resolved. If any required pair is missing or unresolved, including a capped unresolved matched trajectory, withhold the complete-preset interval and record why. Do not form an interval over surviving pairs.
descriptive_uncertainty.node_scope: Split and training variation on one encountered graph under the literal frozen split seeds; no unseen-graph population claim.
descriptive_uncertainty.molecular_and_link_scope: Training randomness conditional on the fixed official data and split; no new-data or molecule/query pseudo-replication claim.
descriptive_uncertainty.old_226_contrast_policy: The ancestor 2480-fit sign-flip/Holm policy is not the expanded 6460-fit reporting family and is not inherited as a claim procedure.

source_and_selection.source_track: Show the declared source settings, horizons, repetition/RNG caveats and native metrics in a distinct source-reference track. A completed fixed source horizon does not assert matched-controller convergence or published full-RNG trajectory equivalence.
source_and_selection.matched_track: Use the matched extended controller and its fixed patience/cap policy. Keep these results distinct from paper/source replication.
source_and_selection.own_selected_predictor: Each predictor uses its own frozen VALID-selected bank/checkpoint and actual declared readout, including required adapters, private BN state, objective/aggregation dependencies and topology. No fallback current/final/recovery state.
source_and_selection.I4: Four independently trained native bodies, each with its own selected checkpoint and epoch; body0 is exactly matched M1. Retain all four IDs, offsets, selected epochs, and body costs. The aggregate/export adds no training fit.
source_and_selection.same_selected_bank_mean: A fixed-mean readout of an already selected learned-readout bank is a labeled diagnostic. It cannot reselect the bank/epoch, tune weights, create another independent trial, or replace the actual declared served predictor.

exposure_and_access.maintain_history: Append new events in a versioned successor with exact scope, role, UTC if known, actor/process if known, local authority hashes, accessed-information class, authorization evidence and resulting decision. Preserve prior events and unknowns.
exposure_and_access.TRAIN_VALID: Exploratory development under the frozen benchmark protocol; this package grants no launch or TEST authorization.
exposure_and_access.TEST_release: Requires a separate exact request with own selected-state hashes, complete official role/query population and topology, evaluator/runtime bindings, actual VALID reconstruction parity, measured resources, evidence/cost wiring and explicit human authorization. Preserve the full authorized output and access receipt; never tune or reselect from TEST.

later_confirmation.remaining_before_confirmation: Freeze its exact scope/candidate/setting, fresh seeds and overlap audit, node split law when applicable, estimand, endpoints, failure/tie rules, budget and human authorization in a separate reviewed protocol.

execution_gates.this_successor_resolves: The accepted exploratory reporting contract and initial exposure ledger only.
execution_gates.still_required: Current-runtime/dispatcher binding, scoped runtime/state/serving qualification, measured resource and cost admission, applicable source-reference fidelity dispositions and explicit human full-campaign GO.
